strings: m_c talks with r_c0 in the medicine den about the pain in the joints of {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} paws.
m_c hisses as {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/try/tries} to walk, the joints in {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} paws feeling off and unbalanced.
With much pain, m_c limps {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} way to the medicine den, {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} paws feeling stiff and awkward.
